question: In which of the following states is the Bhoramdeo temple located, where each year in the last week of March ‘Bhoramdeo Mahotsav’ is celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** 

 
• Bhoramdeo Temple or the ‘Khajuraho of Chhattisgarh’, carved on the rocky stones in the Nagar style is an ancient Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva.
 
• It is situated in the Kabirdham district of Chhattisgarh.
 
• Each year in the last week of March ‘Bhoramdeo Mahotsav’ is celebrated
 
• The temples are said to be built during the reign of King Ramchandra of the Nag Dynasty.
 
• It is similar to the** Khajuraho temple and the Konarak Sun Temple.**
